name: Sponsa
tagline: The gentle CRM for wedding pros who'd rather be creating than chasing.
positioning: Sponsa keeps every inquiry, contract, and payment for your wedding business in one calm place — so no couple ever falls through the cracks.

hero.h1: Run your wedding business without the 11pm spreadsheet spiral
hero.sub: Sponsa gives solo planners, photographers, and florists one warm workspace for inquiries, proposals, contracts, and payment reminders — so every couple feels looked after.

features.title: Inquiries that never slip
features.description: Every 'are you free on our date?' email lands in one inbox with a reply template, so you respond in minutes instead of finding it a week later.

features.title: Proposals couples actually sign
features.description: Send a branded package, contract, and deposit link in a single tidy link. Watch it move from viewed to signed to paid.

features.title: Payment reminders on autopilot
features.description: Sponsa nudges couples about balances and final payments before the big day so you're never the one asking twice.

features.title: A timeline for every booking
features.description: Engagement shoots, tastings, walkthroughs, and delivery dates roll up into one calendar you can trust.

features.title: Client details in one place
features.description: Guest counts, dietary notes, must-have shots, and venue contacts live on each couple's page, not across six threads.

features.title: See your season at a glance
features.description: Know your booked revenue, open inquiries, and slow months so you can plan promotions and time off with confidence.

testimonials.quote: I used to lose inquiries in my personal inbox for days. With Sponsa I reply the same afternoon, and my booking rate for spring weddings jumped noticeably.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The automatic balance reminders alone paid for the whole year. I stopped dreading the awkward money conversation three weeks before every wedding.
testimonials.name: Daniel Whitfield

testimonials.quote: Everything about a couple — their venue, their palette, their timeline — is finally on one page. My assistant and I are never guessing anymore.
testimonials.name: Priya Kapadia

pricing.blurb: For the one-person studio taking on a handful of weddings a season.
For growing vendors juggling a full calendar and a second set of hands.
For established teams running multiple planners or shooters.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sponsa is the earnest, everything-in-one-place CRM built for the people who make weddings happen. Fewer dropped threads, more time to create.
